name: BizOne ERP
description: BizOne ERP gives a small business fast billing, party khata (credit ledger), stock, purchases, payments, expenses, GST, and reports on a phone-first interface. Business-type **packs** add the fields and rules each trade needs: Kirana, Medical Store, Clothing, Hardware, General Retail, Wholesale, Service. An optional **AI Agent** works with the owner's own API key and model.
